thread.title: Nikkei falls, Dainippon Pharma's slide offsets Apple optimism By Reuters

author: Reuters
title: Nikkei falls, Dainippon Pharma's slide offsets Apple optimism By Reuters
text:
© Reuters. Nikkei falls, Dainippon Pharma's slide offsets Apple optimism * SanBio, Dainippon Pharma limit-down on trial news
* Mothers down 8 pct, futures market triggers circuit breaker
* Akebono Brake dives after co says it seeks capital infusion
By Ayai Tomisawa
TOKYO, Jan 30 (Reuters) - Japan's Nikkei fell on Wednesday, with index component Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma plunging after a clinical trial for a new drug failed to complete, offsetting optimism over a spurt in Apple's shares.
The Nikkei share average .N225 declined 0.5 percent to 20,556.54, after opening a tad higher. Though sentiment is weak, the index has managed to stay above its 25-day moving average of 20,325.
Investors initially took heart from Apple Inc's AAPL.O share price jump after the bell as the iPhone maker reported sharp growth in its services business. That followed its warning earlier this month that revenue would be less than previously expected due to softness in China.
Apple supplier Alps Alpine Co 6770.T , which cut its annual operating profit outlook on Tuesday, opened higher supported by a share buyback announcement and strong Apple shares, but it later surrendered gains and was down 3 percent.
Another Apple supplier TDK Corp 6762.T , which is scheduled to report its quarterly earnings on Wednesday, finished 0.6 percent higher.
"Excessive worries about Apple's performance in the Oct-Dec period receded, but iPhone's output has been falling so there is still uncertainty over the April-June quarter and beyond," said Norihiro Fujito, chief investment strategist at Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS ) Securities.
A big drag on the market was Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma Co 4506.T , which dived 19 percent to its daily limit low of 3,065 yen after the drugmaker and SanBio Co 4592.T , which is listed on Tokyo's start-up Mothers market .MTHR , said that the phase 2B study in the United States evaluating SB623 for treatment of chronic stroke did not meet its primary endpoint. contributed a hefty 26 negative points to the Nikkei benchmark index. Sanbio fell nearly 26 percent to the day's limit.
The plunge in Sanbio, which had risen 44 percent in the past month and was the biggest firm by market cap in Mothers, sent shock waves through the entire Mothers market.
The Mothers Index .MTHR fell 8.1 percent, its biggest in almost a year. Trading in Mothers index futures 0#JMI: was temporarily suspended after a circuit breaker was triggered.
"SanBio is a small cap stock that's stealing the thunder from positive Apple talks in the market," said Katsuhiko Nakaumura, a senior technical analyst at Mizuho Securities. "This news is dragging down the entire market and making investors even more risk averse."
Elsewhere, Akebono Brake Industry Co Ltd 7238.T plunged 18 percent even as it announced a plan to turn around operations under an out-of-court scheme and present a revival plan to lenders at a meeting next month. Trouble at its U.S. business had hit the company's earnings. investors turn next to U.S. monetary policy as the Federal Reserve ends a two-day policy meeting at which it is expected to leave interest rates unchanged having raising them four times last year.
The broader Topix .TOPX dropped 0.41 percent to 1,550.76. (Editing by Jacqueline Wong)
